ModMetaData.name: Aragorn – Armee der Toten (Entwicklungsstand)
ModMetaData.author: Aragorn Mod Project
ModMetaData.description: Version 0.15: Story quests in atmospheric English with complete German localization (The Lost Heir, The Blade Reforged, An Oath Unfulfilled), bilingual forge letters, ghost ability labels and a short two-choice dialogue with the Divine Order smith before the first reforging. The 12-hour forge defense, 13 ghost crypt trials, reliable recall, Divine Order property rules and existing ghost mechanics remain unchanged. Gizmo and signature-art concepts are previews only and have not yet been installed in this version.
